profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
Within the advertising industry, being able to communicate effectively with a wide variety of people, both verbally and in written form, is an important skill set. My experience within that industry has provided ample opportunities to sharpen those skills, through meetings with clients and coworkers, and working with account executives to develop content for websites and email marketing. Because of the nature of this position, I worked on multiple projects at a time, in addition to ongoing routine tasks, and became very adept at prioritizing tasks to increase efficiency and ensure that all deadlines were met.

I have experience with HTML5, CSS3, PHP & MySQL, JavaScript, Wordpress, the Adobe Creative Suite, SEO and social media utilization.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for working on a range of projects, from full-scale websites to email marketing, and interacting on a daily basis with graphic designers, account executives and clients.
	- Developed and maintained the front-end functionality of websites.
	- Worked with the back-end developer on content management systems for several projects. - Worked with the back-end developer on content management systems for several projects.
	- Worked with account executives to generate written content for web pages.
	- Participated in pitch meetings and discussions with clients.
	- Wrote cross-browser compliant HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
	- Managed several clients’ MySQL databases.
	- Provided technical support to clients.

positions.title: Deli Supervisor & Assistant Cafe Supervisor
positions.description:
- Responsible for managing the day-to-day business of these departments. 
	- Responsible for orientation and ongoing training for all associates within the departments.
	- Had a role in all interviews and terminations. 
	- Maintained the employee records for each associate.
	- Maintained the employee records for each associate.
	- In charge of all purchasing and inventory management.

positions.title: Student Assistant to the Department of Chemistry Dean
positions.description:
- Maintained the Dean’s calendar and scheduled appointments. 
	- Maintained the files for the department, specifically the graduate school applications.
	- Answered and directed calls.
	- Supported the Administrative Assistants with their tasks.
